descFull: Headless command-line Steam client for Linux and Windows, written in Rust. Install, update and launch Steam games (native or Proton/Wine) from the terminal, plus Steam Cloud saves, Workshop, DLC, collections and friends & chat. An open-source SteamCMD and OpenSteamClient alternative, scriptable with --json.
